meta.name: firebase-basics
meta.description: Provides foundational Firebase CLI setup, CLI installation, version checks (`firebase-tools@latest --version`), CLI login (including --no-localhost), project creation, project selection (`firebase use`), and app config file downloads (`google-services.json`, `GoogleService-Info.plist`). Use ONLY for CLI login, project creation/switching, or downloading app config files. Don't use for Firebase Hosting deploy, Firestore, Auth, App Hosting, Data Connect, Crashlytics, or Remote Config.

copy.tagline: 搭建 Firebase 开发环境,管理项目与配置文件
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果刚开始接触 Firebase,需要快速完成项目环境配置。
copy.tagline_en: Set up Firebase CLI, create projects, and download config files
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you're new to Firebase and need to configure your project environment quickly.

howto.what: 这个技能让你能通过对话完成 Firebase 命令行基础操作：检查 CLI 版本、登录（包括无浏览器方式）、创建或切换项目、下载 Android/iOS 的配置文件。它只处理这些基础配置，不涉及部署、数据库等高级功能。
howto.when: 当你要求登录 Firebase CLI、创建或切换 Firebase 项目、下载 google-services.json 或 GoogleService-Info.plist 配置文件时触发。

say.text: 创建新 Firebase 项目，名字叫 my-app。

say.note: 通过 apps:sdkconfig 获取配置文件。

howto.what_en: This skill lets you handle foundational Firebase CLI tasks through conversation: checking CLI version, logging in (including --no-localhost), creating or switching projects, and downloading Android/iOS config files. It only covers these basics, not deployment, database, etc.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask to log in to Firebase CLI, create or switch Firebase projects, or download google-services.json / GoogleService-Info.plist config files.

say_en.text: Log me in to Firebase CLI.
say_en.note: Runs firebase-tools login; falls back to --no-localhost without a browser.

say_en.text: Create a new Firebase project named my-app.
